definitions.explanation: Describes relationships, situations, or resolutions that are smooth, without conflict or friction. Implies completeness and balance, from the kanji {円|えん} (round, complete).

examples.japanese: {円満|えんまん}な⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}きたい→築く：02046_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: I want to build a harmonious family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{円満|えんまん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}した→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{円満|えんまん}⟦{離婚|りこん}した→離婚する：21333_rikonsuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It has been reported that the two had an amicable divorce.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a な-adjective. Common in describing family life, workplace relationships, and legal/business resolutions. {円満|えんまん}{退職|たいしょく} (amicable resignation) and {円満|えんまん}⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧ (amicable divorce) are set phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {円満|えんまん}な⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧ (harmonious household)
- {円満|えんまん}⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧ (amicable resolution)
- {円満|えんまん}{退職|たいしょく} (amicable resignation)
- {円満|えんまん}⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧ (amicable divorce)
